G=load()

def sides(poly,g,side='left'):
    # poly: list of (r,c) in order; side: 'left' or 'right' of directed polyline
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(len(poly)-1):
        r1,c1=poly[i]; r2,c2=poly[i+1]
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                rr,cc=r-r1,c-c1
                cr,cc2=r2-r1,c2-c1
                cp = cc2*rr - cc*cr2
                if side=='left' and cp>0: out[r][c]=1
                elif side=='right' and cp<0: out[r][c]=1
    return out

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; regs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                col=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                seen[r][c]=True; comp.append((r,c))
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop()
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        n=(x+dr,y+dc)
                        if 0<=n[0]<h and 0<=n[1]<w and not seen[n[0]][n[1]] and g[n[0]][n[1]]==col:
                            seen[n[0]][n[1]]=True; comp.append(n); st.append(n)
                regs.append(comp)
    # find longest components = the segments (lines) — pick components with size>=2 sorted by size desc
    regs.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    segs=regs[:2]
    s1,s2=segs[0],segs[1]
    # bounding box of union
    rs=[x for r in segs for x,_ in r]+[y for _,y in r for r in segs]
    cc=[y for r in segs for _,y in r]+[x for x,_ in r for r in segs]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    fill=r for r in [min(rs),max(rs)]
    for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
        for c in range(min(cc),max(cc)+1):
            if g[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=9
    for (r,c) in [(x,y) for x in segs for y in segs]+[]: pass
    return out

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    runs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        j=0
        while j<W:
            if g[i][j]!=bg:
                j0=j; c=g[i][j]
                while j<W and g[i][j]==c: j+=1
                runs.append((i,j0,c,j-j0))
            else: j+=1
    pc=[r[:3] for r in runs if r[3]==1]      # pixel runs (single cells)
    an=[r for r in runs if r[3]>1]             # bars
    nb=len(pc)
    # anchor = bar with largest row (bottom-most)
    anchor=max(an,key=lambda r:r[0]); other=min(an,key=lambda r:r[0])
    oS,oE=other[1],other[2]; aS,aE=anchor[1],anchor[2]; ar=anchor[0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for (i,j0,c) in pc:
        out[i][j0]=4
        for v in range(i+1,ar): out[v][j0]=3
    # strip at other bar: cols oS+1 .. oS+nb, rows other[0]+1 .. ar (inclusive of anchor row)
    for k in range(oS+1,min(oS+1+nb,W)):
        for v in range(other[0]+1,ar+1): out[v][k]=3
    return out

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # bars = maximal runs of non-bg
    runs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        j=0
        while j<W:
            if g[i][j]!=bg:
                j0=j
                while j<W and g[i][j]==g[i][j0] and g[i][j0]!=bg: j+=1
                runs.append((i,j0,g[i][j0],j-j0))
            else: j+=1
    dots=[r for r in runs if r[3]==1]           # single-cell runs -> 4
    nb=len(dots)
    # near bar = run with smallest row index
    nbar=min(runs,key=lambda r:r[0])
    sb,se=nbar[1],nbar[2]
    # strip: nb bg columns within the bar's column span, from bar start+1
    span_bg=[j for j in range(sb,se+1) if any(r[0]!=nbar[0] and r[1]<=j<=r[2] for r in runs if r[0]!=nbar[0])]
    span_bg=[j for j in range(sb,se+1) if g[nbar[0]][j]==bg or True]
    # simpler: bg cells within span rows
    span_bg=[j for j in range(sb,se+1) if g[0][j]==bg or j>=sb and j<=se and any(g[r][j]==bg for r in range(H))]
    # just: within span, columns that contain any bg cell overall
    span_bg=[j for j in range(sb,se+1) if any(g[r][j]==bg for r in range(H))]
    for j in span_bg[:nb]:
        for v in range(nbar[0]+1,H): out[v][j]=3
    for (i,j,c,_) in dots:
        out[i][j]=4
        for v in range(i+1,H):
            if out[v][j]!=bg and out[v][j]!=c and not any(r[0]==v and r[1]==j and r[3]>1 for r in runs):
                pass
        for v in range(i+1,H):
            if out[v][j]==bg: out[v][j]=3
    return out

a=solve(I); b=O
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,b)): print(i,x,y)

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    runs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        j=0
        while j<W:
            if g[i][j]!=bg:
                j0=j
                while j<W and g[i][j]==g[i][j0] and g[i][j0]!=bg: j+=1
                runs.append((i,j0,g[i][j0],j-j0))
            else: j+=1
    dots=[r for r in runs if r[3]==1]
    bary=min(runs,key=lambda r:r[0])
    bl=bary[1]
    for (i,j,c) in dots:
        out[i][j]=4
        for v in range(i+1,H):
            if out[v][j]==bg: out[v][j]=3

    scols=[(j-(bl+1))%W for _,j,_ in dots]
    for j in set(scols):
        for v in range(bary[0]+1,H):

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    runs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        j=0
        while j<W:
            if g[i][j]!=bg:
                j0=j
                while j<W and g[i][j]==g[i][j0] and g[i][j0]!=bg: j+=1
                runs.append((i,j0,g[i][j0],j-j0))
            else: j+=1
    dots=[r for r in runs if r[3]==1]
    nbar=min(runs,key=lambda r:r[0]); bl=nbar[1]
    # strip: bg columns within near-bar span, offset by pixel positions
    nb=len(dots)
    for j in set((j-(bl+1))%W for _,j,_ in dots):
        for v in range(nbar[0]+1,H):
            if out[v][j]==bg: out[v][j]=3
    for (i,r,c,_) in dots:
        out[i][r]=4
        for v in range(i+1,H):
            if out[v][r]==bg: out[v][r]=3
    return out

import json
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    runs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        j=0
        while j<W:
            if g[i][j]!=bg:
                j0=j
                while j<W and g[i][j]==g[i][j0] and g[i][j0]!=bg: j+=1
                runs.append((i,j0,g[i][j0],j-j0))
            else: j+=1
    dots=[r for r in runs if r[3]==1]
    nbar=min(runs,key=lambda r:r[0]); fl=max(runs,key=lambda r:r[0])[1]
    # strip columns: pixel cols shifted so leftmost pixel sits at bar_left+1
    pl={c for _,c,_,_ in dots}
    shif=(min(pl)-(nbar[1]+1))
    scols=sorted({(c+shif)%W for c in pl})
    for j in scols:
        for v in range(nbar[0]+1,fl):
            if out[v][j]==bg: out[v][j]=3
    for (i,c,col,w) in dots:
        out[i][c]=4
        for v in range(i+1,fl):
            if out[v][c]==bg: out[v][c]=3
    return out
I=G['Demo pair 8 input']; O=G['Demo pair 8 output']
print(solve(I)==O)
T=G['Test input']
res=solve(T)
for r in res: print(r)
print(json.dumps(res))

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    runs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        j=0
        while j<W:
            if g[i][j]!=bg:
                j0=j
                while j<W and g[i][j]==g[i][j0] and g[i][j0]!=bg: j+=1
                runs.append((i,j0,g[i][j0],j-j0))
            else: j+=1
    dots=[r for r in runs if r[3]==1]
    far=max(runs,key=lambda r:r[0])
    fl=far[1]
    scols=sorted({c-fl for _,c,_,_ in dots})
    # dot color -> 4; fill bg cells in scols between bars with 3
    srows=set()
    for (i,c,col,w) in dots: srows.add(i); srows.update(range(i+1,far[0]))
    for v in srows:
        for j in scols:
            if v!=i or out[v][j]==bg: out[v][j]=3 if out[v][j]==bg else out[v][j]
    for i,c,col,w in dots: out[i][c]=4
    return out
